questions.question: How did Job first respond when God challenged him to answer?
options: He laid his hand on his mouth, saying he was of small account
He fled away in great terror from the raging desert storm
He praised himself loudly for all of his past good deeds
He argued back at God, defending his own innocence at great length
questions.answer: He laid his hand on his mouth, saying he was of small account

questions.question: Which great creature did God describe at the end of chapter 40?
